race.comment: FLASHING STAR (2) has race fitness on side third-up and comes off a sound Ballina placing. Extra trip suits and he can get off the mark this time. HOT'N'SMART (6) couldn't get the job done as favourite on debut but keeps Thompson and gets the blinkers applied. Expect him to spear across from the wide draw and give backers a good look. CASTLEREAGH AFFAIR (10) finished alongside him first-up and with improvement to come he's an obvious danger. HARD KNOX (1) was only fair when resuming with a midfield finish in town. Has improvement to come and finds an easier assignment. Expecting him to play a more significant role now.
